annotations.title: Publish from the signed-in NaRabotu account

description: Publishes a vacancy (or up to 50 vacancies in items) or a "looking for work" profile directly from the NaRabotu account the user connected with "Sign in with NaRabotu" (OAuth). NaRabotu validates it like its site form; ads then go to moderation, trusted publishers go live at once.

fields.description: One ad: field values by the posting form field names (city and profession may be names).

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

name: publish
